channels.name: SWCLK
channels.purpose: Serial Wire Clock. Host-generated free-running clock.

channels.name: SWDIO
channels.purpose: Serial Wire Data Input/Output. Bidirectional 1-wire data line; direction-controlled by SWD wire-level FSM with explicit 1-bit Turnaround periods.

channels.name: nTRST
channels.purpose: Optional asynchronous TAP reset (active LOW) — present only on SWJ-DP variants exposing TRST.

channels.name: SWO
channels.purpose: Serial Wire Output. Optional async trace pin carrying ITM/DWT trace packets — separate from SWD protocol.
channels.idle_level: TPIU-driven; idle level depends on encoding

global_signals.name: VDD-IO (per target)
global_signals.purpose: Drives SWD pins' I/O voltage; per-device datasheet.

handshake_pairs.name: SWCLK_DRIVE
handshake_pairs.rule: Free-running clock during a transaction; one bit per rising edge in host-driven phases.

handshake_pairs.name: REQUEST_DRIVE
handshake_pairs.rule: 8-bit Request packet driven on SWDIO during bits 0..7.

handshake_pairs.name: DATA_DRIVE_WRITE
handshake_pairs.rule: 32+1 bits on SWDIO during bits 12..44 for RnW=0.

handshake_pairs.name: DATA_DRIVE_READ
handshake_pairs.rule: 32+1 bits on SWDIO during bits 12..44 for RnW=1.

handshake_pairs.name: LINE_RESET
handshake_pairs.rule: ≥ 50 SWCLK cycles SWDIO=HIGH forces SW-DP to Idle.

handshake_pairs.name: SWJ_DP_MODE_SELECT
handshake_pairs.rule: 16-bit pattern shifted on SWDIO/TMS switches between SWD and JTAG modes.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Host drives SWCLK + SWDIO during Request and Data-Write phases; reads SWDIO during ACK and Data-Read phases. SW-DP FSM is driven by SWCLK rising edges + position within the 46-bit transaction; SWDIO direction-change at explicit Turnaround periods.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Each transaction's data field (read or write) is at bits 12..43 in the 46-bit transaction; Request (bits 0..7) identifies target register and direction; ACK (bits 9..11) gates whether the data field is meaningful. Posted reads compose multiple transactions into a pipeline.

fields.ic_name: ARM Serial Wire Debug (SWD) — ADIv5 (ARM IHI 0031C)

ordering_rules.shift_bit_order: LSB first on SWDIO for all phases.
ordering_rules.data_packet_lsb_order: Bit 0 of 32-bit data first; parity at bit 32.
